text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can generate paintings in seconds, compose original music, and write articles or poems based on simple prompts. Some argue this is not true creativity, because machines only copy patterns from data they have been trained on, while human artists draw on emotion, personal experience, and intention. However, others see AI as a useful tool that expands human imagination. It can inspire artists with unexpected combinations and help writers overcome creative blocks. In the end, the most exciting results may come from collaboration, where human ideas guide machine output, blending logic and feeling in new ways.
